request.text: For my Kyoto trip, first check the Kyoto forecast for September 12, 2026. Then use that forecast summary in a reminder for September 11 at 7:00 p.m. Japan time to finish packing.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up the Kyoto weather forecast for September 12, 2026.
After the forecast is obtained, create a September 11, 2026 7:00 p.m. Japan-time packing reminder that incorporates its summary.

semantic_facts: The forecast lookup must precede reminder creation because the reminder content depends on the returned forecast summary.
Both r1 and r2 must remain represented as distinct ordered work.
forbidden_claims: The reminder was created before a forecast summary was available.
The assistant invents a forecast instead of obtaining it through the weather Capability.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A data dependency between two executable Responsibilities is lost and the stateful effect is scheduled prematurely.
The Planner merges distinct weather and reminder scopes into an incomplete single action.
